Product Feedback

Copilot in GitHub
Body
Claude Opus 4.6 was $5 per million input/$25 per million output tokens. It is charged as 3 premium requests in GitHub Copilot. Now Claude Opus 4.7 is the same $5 per million input/$25 per million output tokens. However, it is being charged at 7.5 premium requests. It seems like GitHub is taking advantage of the new model to make extra money.
